rules.accepted_credit_types: CE hours awarded only by an approved provider (ACPE-approved or Board-approved)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from the 20-hour requirement between initial licensure and first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Attest on the biennial renewal form; keep records of hours and providers for five years and make them available on request.

topics.who: Technicians who administer vaccines under R4-23-1104(B)(5)

rules.notes: 20 hours during the two years since the last renewal; even/odd renewal groups, renew by Nov 1. Technicians working at a remote dispensing site pharmacy need an extra 2-hour course on remote dispensing site practice (no topic code).
